definitions.counterpart_alias_count: number of additional distinct source accessions beyond the first representative; requires whole-genome sequence identity and same nonempty source taxid
definitions.gene_indices: retained as within-record annotation coordinates only; blank for multi-accession loci because annotation indices may differ
definitions.genome: exact whole-genome nucleotide SHA256 + source taxid; missing taxid or nucleotide hash keeps accession-specific units
definitions.locus: connected overlapping inclusive nucleotide window segments within a genome unit; source origin-spanning CDS gaps excluded; adjacency alone does not merge
definitions.negative: every constituent window has a prediction and none meets original Saccharide threshold
definitions.positive: at least one constituent window meets original frozen classifier threshold
definitions.retrieval: P@k is separate and descriptive; no retrieval-positive cutoff declared
definitions.unknown: no observed positive and at least one window has no prediction

plots.visual_review: not yet performed; inspect rendered exports before claiming publication quality

population_scope: selected structure/GT-associated viral candidate cohort; not prevalence among all viruses or taxonomic enrichment
uncertainty_note: 95% Wilson intervals are descriptive; selected and overlapping observations violate independent random-sampling assumptions
